title: "Validated example payloads"

<!-- Generated by npm run generate. Do not edit. -->

Synthetic fixtures. Model and connection names must be replaced with ones configured in your router. JSON request/response fixtures are checked against the actual Rust codecs by `just docs-test-examples`; gRPC bodies are checked against compiled protobuf descriptors during generation. These checks do not prove provider acceptance.

Run HTTP examples from the repository root after setting `ROUTER_URL` and `ROUTER_API_KEY`. Use `curl -N` for SSE. Response examples are illustrative, not recorded provider outputs.

## Minimal chat request

[Download fixture](/examples/chat.json).

`POST /v1/chat/completions`

```json
{
  "model": "chalk/example-chat",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Explain a cache in one sentence."
    }
  ]
}
```

```sh
curl --fail-with-body -N "$ROUTER_URL/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @docs-site/examples/chat.json
```

## Streaming chat with usage

[Download fixture](/examples/chat-stream.json).

`POST /v1/chat/completions`

```json
{
  "model": "chalk/example-chat",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Count to three."
    }
  ],
  "stream": true,
  "stream_options": {
    "include_usage": true
  }
}
```

```sh
curl --fail-with-body -N "$ROUTER_URL/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @docs-site/examples/chat-stream.json
```

## Router decision questions

[Download fixture](/examples/decisions.json).

`POST /v1/alpha/decisions`

```json
{
  "model": "example-connection/example-decision",
  "state": "The request asks to summarize an article.",
  "questions": {
    "category": {
      "type": "choice",
      "instructions": "Classify the requested task.",
      "criteria": {
        "summary": "Summarizing existing material",
        "other": "Any other task"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```sh
curl --fail-with-body -N "$ROUTER_URL/v1/alpha/decisions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @docs-site/examples/decisions.json
```

## List keys with gRPC

[Download fixture](/examples/list-keys.grpc.json).

ProtoJSON for [`ListKeysRequest`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#listkeysrequest). Download contains a type/body envelope; pass only its body to the RPC.

```json
{
  "limit": 40
}
```

## Create a restricted key with gRPC

[Download fixture](/examples/create-key.grpc.json).

ProtoJSON for [`CreateKeyRequest`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#createkeyrequest). Download contains a type/body envelope; pass only its body to the RPC.

```json
{
  "description": "Example integration",
  "permission": {
    "routes": {
      "refs": [
        {
          "publicModelId": "chalk/example-chat"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "labels": {
    "application": "example"
  }
}
```

## Update a key description with gRPC

[Download fixture](/examples/update-key.grpc.json).

ProtoJSON for [`UpdateKeyRequest`](/reference/grpc-api-key/#updatekeyrequest). Download contains a type/body envelope; pass only its body to the RPC.

```json
{
  "key": "synthetic-key-hash",
  "update": {
    "description": "Example renamed integration"
  },
  "updateMask": "description"
}
```
